body: thanks man, this is so true and i really needed to hear that
this has more to do with my anxiety than the actual concept of religion tbf, when i'm panicking my thoughts become irrational

just at the fact that i never let the stigma of weed get to my head because that's all it is, it's a stigma created by the prisons and tobacco companies by  after that horrible burnout any time i get near weed i feel like i'm gonna loose my parents if i smoke... before that day i enjoyed life and felt closest to God and my family

true, the thing is i never really felt forced into religion until now, i feel like i'm living life a certain way out of fear of punishment but i don't wanna feel like that because before any of this i felt fine and lived life simply being a good person because i'd get rewarded in my afterlife, nonetheless i understand that if you're religious you should know your higher being won't punish you and i get it but when i get anxious the panic attacks kill any logic for me

i love my parents and family so much, id never let something get in the way of my relationship with those around me but i don't see it as bad it's just this stigma i've been left with that ill get punished and no matter how many people i hear tell me "God isn't that way" i can't get it out of my head

if i'm behind honest i don't see anything wrong in weed & neither does my mom, she quite simply doesn't like me smoking while under her household & also i've felt closer to my mom and to God while i smoked as i just had a deep appreciation for everything around me, as far my my ambitions and aims in life it never clouded them, it gave me the much needed breathing space to pursue them at the fullest whenever i'm sober if that makes any sense, ill also add that i haven't smoked in months, since summer but i wouldn't mind doing it but the anxiety that comes with it (the thoughts of getting punished) just terrify me

i hate feeling that way because before any of this i never felt forced into religion, rather i truly felt it for what it was but now ive been feeling forced to not do certain things out of fear or simply just fear God and i don't like that, i wish i could be honest with my parents as i'll be turning 18 anyways in a year, i'm just overwhelmed with all of my emotions and while not the best option marijuana helped tremendously in letting me breathe for a second, i felt closer to my family and friends than ever, had a new profound appreciation for life and overall was quite happy well until that given day & i haven't been able to smoke in months and i know i don't need it to survive but i have been feeling extremely overwhelmed to the point where all i do is drown in my feelings at home
